priorityList: Use offensive cooldowns, racial abilities, and trinkets when Takedown (Black Arrow) is active or ready to be cast.
Cast Kill Command if you have zero stacks of Tip of the Spear to generate the buff.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have Tip of the Spear stacks and the ability is about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Takedown (Black Arrow) if you have Tip of the Spear stacks (or at zero stacks if the Twin Fangs talent is active).
Cast Boomstick (Explosive Shot) if you have Tip of the Spear stacks active.
Cast Flamefang Pitch on cooldown if talented.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or if the Raptor Swipe buff is missing.
Cast Kill Command if Takedown (Black Arrow) is about to come off cooldown to ensure you have Tip of the Spear stacks ready.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Kill Command as a general filler to generate Tip of the Spear stacks whenever available.
Cast Takedown (Black Arrow) as a filler if no other higher priority actions are available.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are outside of melee range to continue attacking.
Use a Potion if the target is near death or Takedown (Black Arrow) is ready.
